title: First instrument alto; teacher Charles Sio of the French Opera
summary: He began on alto; his teacher Charles Sio played in the French Opera band. The group struggles to identify the teacher's woodwind instrument.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the first horn: clarinet and saxophone beginnings
